summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, submitting its Philippine SEC Form 17-Q quarterly report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, including management's discussion and analysis and unaudited consolidated financial statements. The filing is a routine periodic report required of a foreign private issuer. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. The registrant is simply complying with its reporting obligations under Philippine regulations and SEC rules. No actionable corporate action or transaction is presented. This is not a special situation; it is a standard quarterly filing.
